headline: TRUMP 🍄 UNVEILS 'SUPER 🧠 INTELLIGENCE FORCE' to OVERSEE 🤝 AI POLICY 📜
text:
TRUMP 🍊 just DROPPED 💥 a brand new SUPER 🧠 INTELLIGENCE FORCE 🛡️ to handle all things 🤖 AI after worries 😟 over the tech 📱 exploded 🌋 everywhere!! The president 🏛️ named his national 🗳️ intelligence chief Jay Clayton 🕴️ as the taskforce's head 👑 while he posted 📬 on Sunday ☀️ that this force will make sure 🇺🇸 the US stays on TOP 🏆 of development 🚀 and coordinates government 👥 engagement with the public 👥!! It comes right after he signed ✍️ an executive order 📜 on 29 September 🗓️ to rename AI as Super Intelligence because the word artificial sounded too FAKE 🦸‍♂️ to him personally!! Trump also announced last week 📅 he would set up a board 🪑 to watch AI safety 🛡️ after top tech bosses 🧑‍💼 signed what he called a morally binding pact 🤝!! "The Super Intelligence Force will coordinate the Federal Government's engagement with Consumers 🛒 Public Interest Groups 🙋 Religious Organizations ⛪ Critical Infrastructure Providers 🏗️ and Super Intelligence Companies 💻" Trump wrote ✍️ while everyone watched 😵!!

Federal Trade Commission Chair Andrew Ferguson 🧑‍⚖️ and Undersecretary of Defense for Research 🧪 Engineering Emil Michael 🛠️ plus Director of the Office of Personnel Management Scott Kupor 👔 will also join the taskforce squad 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! This whole crew reports straight 📈 to the president 🏛️ and White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles 👩‍💼 who keeps things running smooth 🏎️ like a well oiled machine ⚙️!! The taskforce's chief Clayton 🕴️ took office in August 🗓️ as the US national intelligence director after Trump's original pick Bill Pulte got REJECTED 🚫 by lawmakers 🏛️ who said no way 🙅!! On AI he previously said "When something's both an opportunity 💡 and a threat ⚠️ you better get your arms around it" 🤗 while flexing his prosecutor background from the Southern District of New York 👨‍⚖️ where he handled big cases like the drug trafficking one against former Venezuelan President Nicholas Maduro 🌿!!

The announcement dropped amid growing pressure 😤 from big names in the industry like executives from OpenAI 🧠 and Anthropic who want tighter regulation 📏 of the technology fast 🚀!! In an interview on 4 October 🗓️ OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman 🧔 said the benefits of AI justify accepting some of its risks and argued the technology should stay accessible to the public 🌍!! "The world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency" Altman told Politico's newsletter while sounding all philosophical 🧘!! Trump has basically dismissed calls for stronger oversight 🚫 and left it mostly to AI companies to regulate themselves like self policing wolves 🐺!! The pact signed on 29 September 🗓️ includes signatures from execs at OpenAI Anthropic SpaceX 🚀 and Google 🔎 who all lined up to promise they would behave nicely 🕊️!!

On that same day the president signed an executive order 📜 telling all US government departments and agencies to start using the terms SI and Super Intelligence instead of AI which they can no longer acknowledge at all 🚫!! SI will replace AI in official correspondence ✉️ websites 🌐 reports 📊 and every other form of communication from now on according to the order that hit like a thunderbolt ⚡!! Some experts have questioned the logic of this rebranding 🤨 saying that calling it super intelligence might cause massive confusion because it usually means way more advanced systems than what we have now 🧩!! Some top tech leaders have already jumped on the new name including multi billionaire Elon Musk 🚀 who posted on social media that he will rename his firm's AI platform SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI effective immediately 🛎️!!

"SpaceX is a super intelligence company" Musk wrote ✍️ while hyping up his rebrand that ties perfectly into his new gig back in the US government studying the future of war 🪖!! Musk previously served in the Trump administration heading the so called Department of Government Efficiency before his time ended in a very public spat with Trump that had everyone grabbing popcorn 🍿!! This whole Super Intelligence Force move comes after the president renamed everything and now Clayton gets to wrap his arms around both the opportunity and the threat like he promised earlier 🫂 while the taskforce dives headfirst into coordinating with consumers public groups religious folks infrastructure providers and all those super intelligence companies that are built different 🏗️!!
